semiconductor_relevance: High — FNS, Inc. provides critical equipment for semiconductor manufacturing processes, including plasma sources and power supplies.
summary: FNS, Inc. specializes in providing technology solutions for electrical and electronic control devices essential to semiconductor and display manufacturing. Their products, such as Remote Plasma Sources and RF Generators, are integral to thin film deposition and etching processes, enhancing operational efficiency.

regional_presence.Korea: FNS, Inc. is the first company in Korea to develop DLC material-based ESC surface deposition technology, indicating a strong R&D presence.
